name: session-switcher
description: A paged, filterable, taggable switcher over your recent Claude Code sessions, with a per-row activity strip showing when each one was busy. Resumes in the session's own directory.

commandName.description: Slash command that opens the switcher. Tried first; if the name is taken, the built-in keeps it and the mod falls back.
commandName.title: Command name

refresh.description: How many changed transcripts to re-read per open. The rest are served from the cached index.
refresh.title: Transcripts re-read per open
